description: Methodological reference basis used by the FOC experimentation module to justify repeatability, reproducibility, preservation, logging, uncertainty, and comparability decisions.

references.title: NIST SP 800-86
references.why_applies: Supports the forensic workflow basis for collection, examination, analysis, and reporting over preserved digital evidence.

references.title: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3
references.why_applies: Frames detection, triage, response, and evidence-driven incident handling in a structured lifecycle.

references.title: NIST SP 800-82 Rev. 3
references.why_applies: Supports OT and ICS-specific interpretation boundaries, including process-state, PLC, and SCADA context.

references.title: NIST SP 800-92
references.why_applies: Supports log management, alert triage, and event interpretation over preserved records.

references.title: NIST IR 8387
references.why_applies: Supports evidence preservation considerations and intervention boundaries around volatile systems.

references.title: SWGDE Best Practices for Digital Evidence Collection
references.why_applies: Supports cautious evidence collection, traceability, and documentation discipline.

references.title: NIST CFTT
references.why_applies: Supports tool validation awareness and careful interpretation of forensic-tool outputs.

references.title: ISO 5725-1
references.why_applies: Introduces accuracy principles and the methodological distinction between repeatability and reproducibility.

references.title: ISO 5725-2
references.why_applies: Supports experimental design thinking around repeated measurements and between-run variation.

references.title: JCGM VIM Measurement Repeatability
references.why_applies: Defines repeatability under same conditions, used for Level A and stable-conditions Level B interpretation.

references.title: JCGM VIM Measurement Reproducibility
references.why_applies: Defines reproducibility under changed conditions, used for Level C interpretation.

references.title: JCGM VIM Measurement Uncertainty
references.why_applies: Supports explicit uncertainty-aware reporting instead of hiding unresolved variance.

references.title: ACM Artifact Review and Badging
references.why_applies: Supports artifact-centric reproducibility discipline and explicit separation between claims and artifacts.

references.title: MITRE ATT&CK
references.why_applies: Supports technique-centric modeling of the expected incident path and comparison semantics.

references.title: Lakens Equivalence Testing
references.why_applies: Supports explicit threshold-based comparability decisions instead of vague similarity claims.
